summary: Initializes a stream decoder sub-struct. Allocates a 48-byte decoder object through vtable entry 0 of the allocator interface stored at this+0x4, records it at this+0x19C, seeds its first function pointer with PhysicsObjectStateSetter, clears the byte at +0x8 and computes a buffer size (this+0x5C times this+0x64) into +0x28. When the mode flag at this+0x110 equals 2 it installs the audio sample stream path (AudioSampleStream at +0x4, sub_51CF80 at +0xC) and allocates the streaming buffer through vtable entry 1 of this+0x4 into +0x20; otherwise it installs the texture/palette path (VirtualDispatchWrapper_cdf9 at +0x4, TexturePaletteColorLookup at +0xC) and leaves +0x20 null. Finishes by delegating to WheelGeometryDataInitialization.

local_names.a1: container object holding the allocator interface at +0x4 and mode flag at +0x110
local_names.v3: cached buffer size used for the audio-path buffer allocation

operations.description: Allocate the 48-byte decoder sub-struct by calling vtable entry 0 of the interface at this+0x4 with arguments (this, 1, 48) and store the result at this+0x19C
Seed the new sub-struct: its first function pointer v1+0x0 becomes PhysicsObjectStateSetter and the byte at v1+0x8 is cleared
Compute the streaming buffer size as this+0x5C times this+0x64 and write it into v1+0x28
Branch on the mode flag at this+0x110: value 2 selects the audio stream path, every other value selects the texture/palette path
Audio path: install AudioSampleStream at v1+0x4 and sub_51CF80 at v1+0xC
Audio path: allocate the streaming buffer of the computed size via vtable entry 1 of the interface at this+0x4 and store the result at v1+0x20
Texture/palette path: clear v1+0x20 and install VirtualDispatchWrapper_cdf9 at v1+0x4 and TexturePaletteColorLookup at v1+0xC
Delegate the remaining setup to WheelGeometryDataInitialization(a1); the function itself is reached from sub_516C7B (00516C7B)

unresolved: The decoder sub-struct offsets (v1) are not packet fields, so their layout is only partially visible; the allocator interface at this+0x4 has no resolved owner
The exact distinction between the audio stream handlers (sub_51CF80) and the texture/palette handlers is inferred from the mode guard and not independently documented
